shortDescription: Angola's central bank lowered its main interest rate (AOINTR=ECI) by 100 basis points to 14.75% on Tuesday.

children: Angola's central bank lowered its main interest rate (AOINTR=ECI) by 100 basis points to 14.75% on Tuesday.
It was the bank's third consecutive rate cut, following a 125-basis-point reduction in July and a 50 bps cut in May.
Inflation in the Southern African oil producer eased to 8.78% year-on-year (AOCPIY=ECI) in August from 9.33% in July and is at its lowest level in more than a decade.
